info.title: Understudy
info.description: Rehearse-then-dial voice recruiting on the Hunar Voice Agents API.

get.description:
Liveness/capability probe. Reports which optional integrations are configured
so a reviewer running with only a database can see what's degraded and why.

get.summary: The calling window and retry policy every published agent uses
get.description: One fixed, org-wide policy (app/services/guardrails.py) — sent explicitly on every publish rather than left to Hunar's org defaults, precisely so it can be read back here instead of being opaque.

post.description: Stores the raw job description. Nothing is compiled yet — PUT /jobs/{id}/requirements does that.

put.description: Recompiles the raw JD and creates a new draft AgentVersion (origin=COMPILED, unpublished) for every language the compiled JD implies. Never edits an existing version — versions are immutable (CLAUDE.md).

get.summary: Version history with composite score per version

schema.title: Response List Versions Jobs  Job Id  Versions Get

post.summary: Publish a draft version to Hunar
post.description: `language` disambiguates: versions are numbered per (job, language), so version_no alone is not unique across languages.

schema.title: Response List Personas Jobs  Job Id  Personas Get

post.description: Every field falls back to the job's own compiled search_query when omitted, so re-sourcing more of the same needs no body at all.

schema.title: Response List Candidates Jobs  Job Id  Candidates Get

post.description: Blocked candidates are returned WITH reasons, never silently skipped — the consent/DNC guard is unbypassable (CLAUDE.md).

get.description: Refreshes non-terminal outreach rows on read (polling), then reads whatever state is current — the board is correct even if Hunar's webhooks never arrive.
One row per candidate, one column per screening question id plus the four standard result fields, pulled from each candidate's latest call result.

get.summary: One agent version's full built prompt and result schema

post.description: Runs all six personas against this version and scores the result. Returns immediately with a run id in PENDING status; poll GET /runs/{id} for progress.

get.summary: This version's most recent rehearsal run, if it has one
get.description: null if the version has never been rehearsed — a valid state, not an error, so this returns 200 rather than 404.

schema.title: Response Get Latest Run Versions  Version Id  Latest Run Get

get.summary: A rehearsal run's status, scores, and per-case summaries
One persona's full transcript, extraction, ground truth, metrics and failures

post.summary: Propose a prompt patch addressing this run's worst failures

post.description: Creates AgentVersion n+1 (origin=PATCHED) from the patch's prompt, then immediately rehearses it against the same personas as the parent run — a patch's effect is measured, never assumed.

patch.summary: Update a candidate's phone, language, or DNC flag
patch.description: A plain field edit — unlike POST .../consent, this never sets consent_recorded_at. The outbound-call guard still checks consent independently at call time regardless of what phone_e164 is set to here.

post.description: Sets phone_e164 and consent_recorded_at together — the only route that does, per CLAUDE.md's rule that a call needs an explicitly consented number.

`kind` is one of status|recording|result|summary. The signature is verified over the RAW request body (see app/integrations/hunar/signature.py); an invalid signature returns 401 and is never applied. An unrecognised call/request id is still accepted (200) and logged rather than erroring, since Hunar would otherwise retry a payload it has no way to fix. `X-Hunar-Signature` is this project's assumed header name for the signature — CLAUDE.md documents the HMAC computation itself but not the header carrying it.

schema.title: Response Receive Hunar Webhook Webhooks Hunar  Kind  Post

get.summary: Recent raw webhook events, valid or not
get.description: The append-only log every inbound Hunar webhook is recorded to, regardless of whether its signature verified or it resolved to a known call — see WebhookEvent's docstring. Diagnostic only.

schema.title: Response List Webhook Events Debug Webhooks Get

AgentVersionRead.title: AgentVersionRead
AgentVersionRead.description:
GET /versions/{id} — the version's full built prompt/schema, not just its identity
(VersionSummary/VersionHistoryRow carry only the latter). Needed wherever a screen must
show or diff against the exact text that was built for this version, e.g. the rehearsal
screen's patch DiffView, which diffs the current agent_prompt against a proposed one.

BlockedCandidate.title: BlockedCandidate
BlockedCandidate.description:
One candidate call_candidates refused to dial, and why. Recruiters must see this list —
per CLAUDE.md the guard is unbypassable, so a skip is never silent.

BoardRow.title: BoardRow
BoardRow.description:
One candidate plus their latest outreach attempt, if any. Fields from Outreach are None
when the candidate has never been called.

CandidatePatch.title: CandidatePatch
CandidatePatch.description:
PATCH /candidates/{id} — phone, language, dnc, per the API surface. Every field is
optional; only what is provided is changed.

CaseSummary.title: CaseSummary
CaseSummary.description:
One row of RunRead.case_summaries — enough to pick a case to drill into, not the full
transcript (see GET /runs/{id}/cases/{case_id} for that).

Language.title: Language
Language.description: Belongs to the agent, not the call — see CLAUDE.md.

RequirementsUpdate.title: RequirementsUpdate
RequirementsUpdate.description:
Body for PUT /jobs/{id}/requirements — a revised raw JD. Recompiling always creates new
draft AgentVersion row(s); it never edits an existing one (CLAUDE.md: versions immutable).

SourceRequest.title: SourceRequest
SourceRequest.description:
Body for POST /jobs/{id}/source. Every field optional — omitted fields fall back to the
job's own compiled search_query, so 'source more like this' needs no body at all.

VersionHistoryRow.title: VersionHistoryRow
VersionHistoryRow.description:
One row of GET /jobs/{id}/versions: a version plus its most recent rehearsal composite,
if it has been rehearsed at all.

tags.name: jobs
tags.description: A job holds the raw JD, its compiled requirements, agent versions, sourced candidates, and the live call board. Requirements are compiled into a new draft AgentVersion per language — versions are immutable, never edited in place.

tags.name: rehearsal
tags.description: Rehearse an agent version against six comparable personas before it ever calls a real person, score the result on four independent metrics, and patch the prompt to fix what failed — with the patch's effect measured by re-rehearsing, never assumed.

tags.name: candidates
tags.description: Per-candidate edits and consent. A call is only ever placed with an explicitly consented number (or one on the demo allow-list) — see POST /jobs/{id}/call's unbypassable guard.

tags.name: webhooks
tags.description: Inbound Hunar call-lifecycle events. Signature-verified, append-only logged regardless of outcome, and idempotent — GET /jobs/{id}/board's own polling is what keeps the board correct even if these never arrive.

tags.name: debug
tags.description: Diagnostic read-only views, not part of the product surface.
